What held the copy back: No customer names, quotes or case studies found - the copy can describe the product but cannot prove anyone uses it
What would help most next time: Resolve this simulated next-step obstacle: told me exactly what document formats it reads (PDF? Google Doc? Notion?) and given one concrete number — how long setup takes or what it costs after the free tier — so I could judge if this is a 10-minute trial or a half-day project I don't have time for today. Check existing verified material first; surface a supported answer or documentation link appropriate to the CTA. If absent, obtain this specific information. Reader expectations are not product evidence.
